name: Pico Bl, Crenshaw Bl to Bonnie Brae St
source: Path taken from the LA Metro GTFS shape for line 30 (shape 300832_JUNE26, 2026 feed).
notes: LADOT's Pico Boulevard Safety and Mobility Project covers about 3.5 miles of Pico Bl from Crenshaw Bl to Figueroa St: two travel lanes each way become one plus a center turn lane, with curb-protected bike lanes, new signals at Manhattan Pl and New Hampshire Av, shorter crossings, sidewalk and curb-ramp repairs, north-side parking removed and some bus stops relocated. Metro line 30 is the only Metro line on this stretch, and it leaves Pico at Bonnie Brae St (via Union Av and Olympic Bl, rejoining at Figueroa St), so the corridor stops at Bonnie Brae St and the easternmost 0.6 mi of the project (Bonnie Brae St to Figueroa St) has no bus data. All three sections are inside the project; there is no untreated control section on Pico itself (line 30 starts at Pico / Rimpau, just west of Crenshaw). LADOT estimates peak-hour travel could rise by about one to two minutes per mile. Facts come from LAist (2026-03-09, 2026-07-10) and Spectrum News (2026-07-29); the LADOT project page is rendered by JavaScript and could not be read from the session, so re-check dates against it before publication.
